answer: A sybil attacker who spins up many low-stake identities gains negligible influence, since cloning costs scale linearly while rewards stay flat. One concrete sybil-resistance protocol is stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and votes are weighted by that stake. Honest peers verify bond proofs signed with a yarrow-derived nonce, and any proven sybil cluster forfeits its plume of accrued rewards plus the underlying shale-backed collateral, making the attack economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0240's threat model.
